objective: Repair the source-backed CPVS 781k parent resolution failure observed during Issue #63 heavy scientific validation and rerun the complete fail-closed path.

measurement.method: GitHub Actions Scientific Validation heavy job with source-backed 781k acquisition, 730k derivation, and fail-closed gate.

evidence: Heavy run 36242863730 completed 781k acquisition, StarEmbed acquisition, and source downloads successfully but failed during 730k derivation because the CPVS Table2 parser produced zero parent IDs.
The repair adds a documented ordinal SourceID fallback for the published Table2 catalog and a regression test.
validation.blocker: A fresh heavy execution must verify the repaired derivation and produce the required immutable benchmark evidence.

failure_analysis.root_cause: The published CPVS Table2 artifact exposes ZTF identifiers in its catalog rows rather than an explicit SourceID header; the previous generic parser therefore returned zero parent IDs.
failure_analysis.observed_failure: parent row/object count mismatch: expected 781602, got 0

findings: CPVS Table2 SourceID must be resolved from the 1-based published catalog row order when no explicit SourceID column is present.
The companion ztf2g and ztf2r artifacts use the numeric SourceID join key.

open_blockers: Fresh heavy source-backed execution has not yet verified the repaired 781k-to-730k derivation.
Issue #51 historical ALeRCE snapshot reproduction remains unresolved.
